description:
FILED s521c (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) from the #1576 one-file acceptance runs of Path-Tiny t/rel-abs.t (stops in subtest "relative on absolute paths with symlinks" ... remove_tree) and t/filesystem.t.

SILENT WRONG: after `lstat(SYMLINK)` the `_` stat buffer answers `-d _` TRUE for a symlink to a directory (it followed the link); perl's `_` holds the lstat result, so `-d _` is false.  File::Path's remove_tree uses exactly that (`lstat $root; -d _`) to decide whether to descend, so PCL chdirs INTO the symlinked directory and File::Path's own safety check aborts: "directory .../A/B changed before chdir, expected dev=.. ino=N, actual ino=M, aborting".

REPRO (probed, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL on 68aeebf5 + s521c, scratch/s521c/pr/lst.pl):
    use File::Temp qw(tempdir); my $d = tempdir(CLEANUP => 1);
    mkdir "$d/real"; symlink "$d/real", "$d/ln" or die;
    lstat("$d/ln"); print "lstat-then-_d=", (-d _ ? 1 : 0), "\n";      # perl 0, PCL 1
    use File::Path qw(remove_tree); mkdir "$d/A"; symlink "$d/real", "$d/A/B";
    remove_tree("$d/A");      # perl: removed, target kept; PCL: dies (changed before chdir)
(`(lstat)[1]` vs `(stat)[1]` differ correctly and `-l` is right: the bug is the `_` buffer a VOID / list lstat leaves.)  Family #1047 (the `_` cache records which stat filled it).
REACH: Path-Tiny rel-abs.t (stops after 33 of its rows), every remove_tree over a tree holding a symlink to a directory.


=== DONE (s538a, Opus, 2026-11-12; commit 360be690, cl/ only) ===
The `_` buffer remembered the operand and the flavour, but re-read it with the READER's syscall: `lstat $link; -d _`
followed the link (File::Path's remove_tree descended into a symlinked directory and aborted 'changed before chdir').
%p-stat-operand, the one operand resolver, returns a third value LSTATP -- OP's own flavour for a fresh operand, the
remembered one for `_` -- and no caller picks the syscall (%p--stat-test's :lstat key is gone).  Probes pr/s3554a.pl: 17
lines tree = perl except one error location (#4786, filed by the review, pre-existing).  Guard Pl/t/bareword-fh-slot-01.t
rows 99-106 (x2), inverse-verified.  ir-spec §10c.
BOARD: Path-Tiny filesystem.t (perl 108): base 90 ok / 3 not ok, no plan, rc 2 -> 105 ok / 3 not ok to its plan (rows 11 70 71,
blessed: #2006 PART 2, #2853); rel-abs.t (perl 33): base 33 ok, no plan, rc 2 -> 33 / 0 PASS.  CLOSE-WITH-ROWS: filesystem.t *PLAN* + rel-abs.t *PLAN* (#3554) left the board baseline.
